decks.ac:
* Auto-generated SPICE netlist - Flyback DC-DC Converter
* Auto-grounded net 1 due to VIN:-
* Created internal net n7 for RSN_P:neg -> CSN_P:pos
* Created internal net n8 for RSN_S:neg -> CSN_S:pos
.options rshunt=1e+12 cshunt=1e-12 reltol=0.01 abstol=1e-09 vntol=1e-05 chgtol=1e-11 gmin=1e-10
.options method=gear maxord=2 trtol=4
.model nmos_model NMOS(Vto=3 Lambda=0.01 Kp=25 Cbd=1n Cbs=1n Cgdo=100p Is=1e-14 Tt=100n Rs=0.01)
.model Dmodel D(Is=1e-12 n=1.1 Rs=0.1 Cjo=1e-11 Tt=1e-08 Bv=100 Ibv=1e-06)
* --- Transformer (parametric, series-R + core loss) ---
.subckt Xfmr P1 P2 S1 S2 params: Lm=100u Ns=3.6 K=0.99 Rwp=0.5 Rws=0.1 Rcore=1e6 Cww=0
Rwp  P1  P1a {Rwp}
Rws  S1  S1a {Rws}
Lp   P1a P2  {Lm}
Ls   S1a S2  {Lm*Ns*Ns}
K1   Lp  Ls  {K}
Rcore P1a P2 {Rcore}
Cww  P1a S1a {Cww}
.ends Xfmr

VIN VIN_src 0 PWL(0 0 0.003 12)
RVIN_series VIN_src n0 0.05
VPWM n_PWM_int 0 PULSE(0 12 0 1e-07 1e-07 4.7e-06 1e-05)
RPWM_drive n_PWM_int n2 100
VSW_SENSE n3 n_SW_dsense 0
MSW n_SW_dsense n2 0 0 nmos_model
VT1_SENSE_PRI n0 n_T1_p1_sense 0
VT1_SENSE_SEC n4 n_T1_s1_sense 0
XT1 n_T1_p1_sense n3 n_T1_s1_sense n6 Xfmr Lm=4e-05 Ns=2 K=-0.985 Rwp=0.5 Rws=0.1 Rcore=1e+06 Cww=2e-11
RSN_P n3 n7 22
CSN_P n7 n0 2.2e-08
RSN_S n4 n8 100
CSN_S n8 n6 1e-09
R_ISO n6 0 1e+08
VD_SENSE n4 n_D_sense 0
RD_SENSE_DAMP n_D_sense n_D_damp 0.001
D n_D_damp n5 Dmodel
VCout_SENSE n5 n_Cout_sense 0
LCout_ESL n_Cout_sense n_Cout_esl 1e-10
RCout_ESR n_Cout_esl n_Cout_esr 0.02
Cout n_Cout_esr n6 0.0001 IC=0
RCout_LEAK n5 n6 2.5e+07
VR_LOAD_SENSE n5 n_R_LOAD_sense 0
LR_LOAD_PL n_R_LOAD_sense n_R_LOAD_mid 1e-08
R_LOAD n_R_LOAD_mid n6 50

.end

.control
set noaskquit
set nomoremode
set numdgt=9

.endc

* Transient Requirement tr_reg: Meet target Vout across line (Vin) and load changes
tran 4e-07 0.015 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
let Vout_avg_diff = v(n5) - v(n6)
meas tran Vout_avg avg Vout_avg_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vout_avg
let Vout_ripple_vpp_diff = v(n5) - v(n6)
meas tran Vout_ripple_vpp pp Vout_ripple_vpp_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vout_ripple_vpp
meas tran Vin_avg avg v(n0) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vin_avg
meas tran Iin_avg avg i(vin) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Iin_avg
meas tran Iout_avg avg i(vr_load_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Iout_avg
wrdata time_series/tr_reg_IIN.csv i(vin)
let VIN = v(n0)
wrdata time_series/tr_reg_VIN.csv v(n0)
let VOUT_csv_diff = v(n5) - v(n6)
let VOUT = VOUT_csv_diff
wrdata time_series/tr_reg_VOUT.csv VOUT_csv_diff
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM.csv v(n2)
let v_SW_auto = v(n3)
wrdata time_series/V_SW.csv v_SW_auto
wrdata time_series/I_SW.csv i(VSW_SENSE)
let v_SW_gate_auto = v(n2)
wrdata time_series/Gate_SW.csv v_SW_gate_auto
let v_T1_auto = v(n0) - v(n3)
wrdata time_series/V_T1.csv v_T1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_T1_pri.csv i(VT1_SENSE_PRI)
wrdata time_series/I_T1_sec.csv i(VT1_SENSE_SEC)
wrdata time_series/I_T1.csv i(VT1_SENSE_PRI)
let v_D_auto = v(n4) - v(n5)
wrdata time_series/V_D.csv v_D_auto
wrdata time_series/I_D.csv i(VD_SENSE)
let v_Cout_auto = v(n5) - v(n6)
wrdata time_series/V_Cout.csv v_Cout_auto
wrdata time_series/I_Cout.csv i(VCout_SENSE)
let v_R_LOAD_auto = v(n5) - v(n6)
wrdata time_series/V_R_LOAD.csv v_R_LOAD_auto
wrdata time_series/I_R_LOAD.csv i(VR_LOAD_SENSE)
plot i(vin) title 'tr_reg_IIN'
plot v(n0) title 'tr_reg_VIN'
plot VOUT_csv_diff title 'tr_reg_VOUT'
plot v(n2) title 'Gate_PWM'
plot v_SW_auto title 'V_SW'
plot i(VSW_SENSE) title 'I_SW'
plot v_SW_gate_auto title 'Gate_SW'
plot v_T1_auto title 'V_T1'
plot i(VT1_SENSE_PRI) title 'I_T1_pri'
plot i(VT1_SENSE_SEC) title 'I_T1_sec'
plot i(VT1_SENSE_PRI) title 'I_T1'
plot v_D_auto title 'V_D'
plot i(VD_SENSE) title 'I_D'
plot v_Cout_auto title 'V_Cout'
plot i(VCout_SENSE) title 'I_Cout'
plot v_R_LOAD_auto title 'V_R_LOAD'
plot i(VR_LOAD_SENSE) title 'I_R_LOAD'

* Transient Requirement tr_dyn: Dynamic response: step changes (line/load) with minimal overshoot and fast settling
tran 1e-06 0.015 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
let Vout_max_diff = v(n5) - v(n6)
meas tran Vout_max max Vout_max_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vout_max
let Vout_min_diff = v(n5) - v(n6)
meas tran Vout_min min Vout_min_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vout_min
let VOUT_diff = v(n5) - v(n6)
let VOUT_diff = v(n5) - v(n6)
meas tran rise_time_10_90 TRIG VOUT_diff VAL=1.2000000000000002 RISE=1 TARG VOUT_diff VAL=10.8 RISE=1
print rise_time_10_90
let VOUT_diff = v(n5) - v(n6)
meas tran settle_to_upper TRIG AT=1e-06 TARG VOUT_diff VAL=12.059999999999999 CROSS=LAST
print settle_to_upper
let VOUT_diff = v(n5) - v(n6)
meas tran settle_to_lower TRIG AT=1e-06 TARG VOUT_diff VAL=11.94 CROSS=LAST
print settle_to_lower
meas tran Isw_peak max i(vsw_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Isw_peak
meas tran Isw_ripple pp i(vsw_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Isw_ripple
meas tran demag_done_time TRIG AT=1e-06 TARG i(vd_sense) VAL=0 CROSS=LAST
print demag_done_time
meas tran Vsw_overshoot max v(n3) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vsw_overshoot
wrdata time_series/tr_dyn_ID.csv i(vd_sense)
wrdata time_series/tr_dyn_ISW.csv i(vsw_sense)
let VSW = v(n3)
wrdata time_series/tr_dyn_VSW.csv v(n3)
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM.csv v(n2)
plot i(vd_sense) title 'tr_dyn_ID'
plot i(vsw_sense) title 'tr_dyn_ISW'
plot v(n3) title 'tr_dyn_VSW'
plot v(n2) title 'Gate_PWM'

print Isw_avg
meas tran Isw_rms rms i(vsw_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Isw_rms

linearize
meas tran Vsw_max max v(n3) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vsw_max
meas tran Isw_peak max i(vsw_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Isw_peak
meas tran Isw_rms rms i(vsw_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Isw_rms

.endc
